safety_invariants: canonical evidence must resolve to native transcript spans
approved provider/model route and release identity
required_implementation: append-only versioned ReportProfileRegistry and field mappings
draft approval and audited activation for new plans only
read-only effective policy and provenance diagnostics
bounded extras plus recoverable repair state for provider drift
acceptance: schema and property tests for bounds and unknown keys
tenant isolation and append-only audit tests
plan freeze retry replay and rollback tests
provider shape evidence and report mapping tests
guest and authenticated synthetic upload-to-report receipt

fallback.invalid_output: retain transcript and raw receipt, mark needs-repair, never fabricate or charge a second unapproved run

stop_condition: Do not activate a policy/profile revision until validation, audit, shadow comparison, plan freeze, and rollback proof pass.
rejected_alternatives: editing constants or live database rows as runtime authority
unbounded admin JSON or arbitrary provider selection

skill_evolution.improvement: Require an agility inventory that classifies each constant as safety invariant or product knob before adding an Admin/CLI setting.
